svg.title: THE LITTLE SWARM WORKSHOP · demonstration activity calendar
svg.desc: GitHub-style calendar of observed source events, with a deterministic swarm of tiny robots ferrying symbolic work to recorded event dates. This does not represent the complete GitHub contribution graph or autonomous GitHub actions.
svg.text: SOURCE-OBSERVED EVENTS · THE AGENTS ARE A VISUAL METAPHOR
